database_harness.pattern: backend/scripts/mcr/migration_smoke.py — a marker-owned mcr-pg-* cluster in /tmp, no TCP listener, no inherited credentials

deviations.detail: WP-02's task list named profile_avatars but the schema it delivered (0080–0085) does not contain it; only profile_media, profile_rooms, intro_*, profile_posts and the deletion ledger were created. WP-08 therefore authors the table itself as 0086_profile_avatars.sql, strictly greater than the 0085 head, with no applied migration edited.

domain-contract.md §4 names the column `config jsonb` and leaves the shape to the avatar catalog. The column stores the canonical core.AvatarConfig object; the catalog validates its contents and the column only fixes jsonb_typeof = 'object'.

The foundation has no account_context_version anywhere in backend/. WP-08 implements the client half (recognize, clear, refuse without writing) and does not invent the header or the status. Recorded as PARTIAL, not PASS.

The concert authority fetched /api/concert/events/{eventId}/bootstrap to learn the reviewed manifest. A profile avatar has no event, so the profile authority takes the pinned manifest document from the shell's own release read and issues no event-scoped request. The shell admission (admitProfileAvatar) checks the account, not an event.

entities/emo-avatar/runtime.ts widens MotionAuthority to a union of TEST_ONLY and REVIEWED_PRODUCTION. The editor's save gate reads canSave, which only the production variant carries, so a fixture authority cannot satisfy it.

deviations.item: The concert editor is not deleted
deviations.detail: features/avatar/motion-adoption/ and entities/avatar/runtime/motion-adoption/ remain in place for the concert product, which still uses the event-scoped avatar. WP-08 adds the profile implementation beside them and switches the shell's avatar view to it. The task's Writes scope is features/profile-avatar/ and entities/emo-avatar/; deleting the concert implementation would break the concert routes and is not in this scope.

The shell still falls back to WholeCharacterEditor or AvatarEditor when the release is not the reviewed motion character. Those are not character fallbacks: they are different admitted representations of the same profile avatar, and the reviewed-motion path never substitutes one for a failed art load.

limitations: No live HTTP server was started: the route layer is exercised through its pure parser and its handler against a real database, not over a socket. Gateway dispatch for /api/me/avatar already exists in the frozen profile route table (WP-02), but the profile producer does not yet serve the avatar operation; wiring it is a gateway/profile-service composition change outside this package's Writes scope.
V-09-a (room) and the media/room halves of V-09-c belong to other packages.
